sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九的隐形。

sentences.en: There is so much to do at the mall.
sentences.zh: 商场里有太多好玩的事了。

sentences.en: You can get your ears pierced.

sentences.zh: 你可以去手工造个泰迪熊。

sentences.en: You can go get an Orange Julius.
sentences.zh: 你可以去买一杯橙 Julius 冰饮。

sentences.en: Late at night, when the GameStops and the Hot Topics are all locked up
sentences.zh: 深夜时分，当游戏驿站和热点百货都已上锁

sentences.en: and the food court's taking out the last of the trash,
sentences.zh: 当美食广场在清理最后一袋垃圾时，

sentences.en: it is usually time to go home.
But what if the mall was your home?
sentences.zh: 但如果商场就是你的家呢？

sentences.en: This ad came on for the Providence Place Mall.
sentences.zh: 当时普罗维登斯广场购物中心的广告播了出来。

sentences.en: It was this woman talking about how it was going to be so convenient for her
sentences.zh: 视频里这个女人在谈论，买齐她和孩子们所需的全部东西

sentences.en: to get everything that she needed for her kids, for herself,
if only she could live there.
sentences.zh: 只要她能住在那里就好了。

sentences.en: I just had this idea, oh, we should live in the mall.
sentences.zh: 我当时就冒出了这个想法：哦，我们应该住在商场里。

sentences.en: The new documentary Secret Mall Apartment is about a group of artists
sentences.zh: 这部全新纪录片《秘密商场公寓》讲述了一群艺术家

sentences.en: who built, you guessed it, a secret apartment inside of the mall.
sentences.zh: 他们在商场里建造了一间秘密公寓，正如你所猜到的那样。

sentences.en: We interviewed the group's ringleader, Michael Townsend, a few years back.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我们采访了该团伙的头目迈克尔·汤森。

sentences.en: And after the story, we'll have an update about what's happened since then.
sentences.zh: 在这段故事之后，我们会带来一份关于此后进展的最新报道。

sentences.en: In downtown Providence, Rhode Island, there's a large plot of land
sentences.zh: 在罗德岛州普罗维登斯市的市中心，有一块巨大的土地

sentences.en: that sits on the bank of the Woonosquaducket River.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在乌农索斯夸切特河畔。

sentences.en: In 1838, it was the home of the Rhode Island State Prison,
sentences.zh: 1838年，这里曾是罗德岛州立监狱的所在地，

sentences.en: which was notorious for its horrid smell, dreary outward appearance,
sentences.zh: 该监狱以其恶臭、阴暗的外观
以及因实施单独监禁而闻名遐迩。

sentences.en: Later, the land housed the continuing education campus
sentences.zh: 后来，这片土地成为了罗德岛大学

sentences.en: for the University of Rhode Island.
And after that, a dirt parking lot called Ray's Parkin' Lock.
sentences.zh: 再后来，这里变成了一个名为“雷的停车锁”的泥泞停车场。

sentences.en: Then, in 1999, in a grand effort to revitalize the city,
sentences.zh: 接着，在1999年，为了振兴这座城市，

sentences.en: and with much fanfare, the Providence Place Mall was opened.
sentences.zh: 在一片盛大的欢呼声中，普罗维登斯广场购物中心开业了。

sentences.en: That's Vanessa Lowe, producer of the podcast, Nocturne.
sentences.zh: 那是瓦妮莎·洛，播客《夜曲》的制作人。

sentences.en: The mall, costing $500 million, was what was known as a super regional,
sentences.zh: 这座耗资5亿美元的商场被称为超级区域性商场，

sentences.en: a one-stop shopping destination, housing everything consumers could possibly want or need
sentences.zh: 是一个一站式购物目的地，在一个完全封闭的空间里
容纳了消费者可能想要或需要的一切。

sentences.en: Partially funded by taxpayer money, it spanned 13 acres,
sentences.zh: 它部分由纳税人的资金资助，占地13英亩，

sentences.en: offered 1.4 million square feet of retail space,
sentences.zh: 提供140万平方英尺的零售空间，
并且占据了整个河岸区。

sentences.en: It was the largest construction project in Providence's history.
sentences.zh: 这是普罗维登斯历史上最大的建筑项目。

sentences.en: Oh, this one building, and we sort of stood in awe watching it get built.
sentences.zh: 哦，就这么一栋建筑，我们有点敬畏地看着它拔地而起。

sentences.en: Michael Townsend is an artist who lived nearby when the mall was still under construction in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·汤森是一名艺术家，在20世纪90年代商场仍在建设时，他就住在附近。

sentences.en: His daily running route took him past the construction site,
sentences.zh: 他日常的跑步路线会经过施工现场，

sentences.en: and Michael says that as he watched it go up, he had an open mind about the project.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，当他看着它一点点建起来时，他对这个项目抱持着开放的心态。

sentences.en: He was cautiously optimistic that it would be a welcome addition to the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他持谨慎乐观的态度，认为它会为这个社区带来一个受欢迎的新成员。

sentences.en: But yeah, that didn't last long.
sentences.zh: 但好吧，那并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: It's funny, the revulsion to a building like that doesn't really kick in until the skin gets put on.
sentences.zh: 说来也搞笑，对那种建筑的厌恶感，直到外墙挂上之前是不会真正爆发的。

sentences.en: When something is in its erector set mode, when you're just seeing the skeleton,
sentences.zh: 当某个东西还处于骨架拼装阶段，当你只能看到它的钢筋铁骨时，

sentences.en: you're like, oh, that's a pretty cool skeleton.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得：哦，这骨架还挺酷的。

sentences.en: But as soon as the flesh is there, you're like, ooh, not pretty.
sentences.zh: 但一旦血肉丰满起来，你就会觉得：呃，真不好看。

sentences.en: Providence Place was going to be a big, boxy stack of shops
sentences.zh: 普罗维登斯广场将是一个巨大的、方块状的商店堆砌体，

sentences.en: without much in the way of architectural niceties.
sentences.zh: 在建筑美感上乏善可陈。

sentences.en: And on his runs, Michael watched as that big box
sentences.zh: 在跑步过程中，迈克尔眼睁睁看着那个大盒子

sentences.en: was slowly filled with the things that make a mall a mall.
sentences.zh: 慢慢填满了让商场成其为商场的种种设施。

sentences.en: As it's being built, I started to sort of do mental maps of spaces.
sentences.zh: 在它建造的过程中，我开始在脑海中对这些空间进行规划。

sentences.en: You know, that's going to be a store, that's going to be a storage space, that's going to be parking.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是家商店，那是储藏室，那是停车场。

sentences.en: But amidst all the construction, there was one part of the building that kept catching Michael's eye.
sentences.zh: 但在所有的建设当中，建筑里有一个部分一直吸引着迈克尔的目光。

sentences.en: A weird space in the guts of the architecture that didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 那是建筑内部一个说不通道理的奇怪空间。

sentences.en: I thought that was really odd.
It didn't seem to meet the profile of either a storage space or a parking space or a store space.
sentences.zh: 它既不符合储藏室的轮廓，也不符合停车场或商铺的轮廓。

sentences.en: Michael wasn't sure what the space was for.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔不确定这个空间到底是做什么用的。

sentences.en: It seemed to exist only by virtue of the walls intended for the more legitimate spaces around it.
sentences.zh: 它似乎仅仅因为周围那些更正规的空间所预留的墙壁而存在。

sentences.en: But the result was this room.
sentences.zh: 但最终的结果就是这样一个房间。

sentences.en: It was an accidental room, a remainder left over by the long division of the mall's architecture.
sentences.zh: 这是一个意外的房间，是商场建筑长久分割后剩下的边角料。

sentences.en: I had never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我从来没见过这样的东西。

sentences.en: And every time I ran by it, it was something that I would think about.
sentences.zh: 每次我从它旁边跑过，我都会想起它。

sentences.en: Michael eventually put the strange room out of his mind.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔最终把这个奇怪的房间抛到了脑后。

sentences.en: He probably would have forgotten about it entirely.
sentences.zh: 他可能早就把它忘得一干二净了。

sentences.en: Except that four years later, a second group of developers, encouraged by the success of Providence Place, set their sights even closer to Michael.
sentences.zh: 除非四年后，受普罗维登斯广场成功的鼓舞，第二批开发商将目光投向了离迈克尔更近的地方。

sentences.en: This time, they wanted to build right on top of the historic mill district, where Michael and a dozen or so other artists lived and worked,
sentences.zh: 这一次，他们想直接在历史悠久的磨坊区上方动土，迈克尔和其他十多位艺术家就在这里生活和工作，

sentences.en: in an old industrial building they called Fort Thunder.
sentences.zh: 在一栋他们称之为“雷霆堡”的老工业建筑里。

sentences.en: The developers had used a computer algorithm to figure out where to place a new supermarket, so that it wouldn't compete with other supermarkets in the area.
sentences.zh: 开发商利用计算机算法来计算新超市的选址，以确保它不会与该地区的其他超市产生竞争。

sentences.en: And I got to see this computer printout, and it's sort of like a nuclear explosion map.
sentences.zh: 我看到了这张电脑打印件，它有点像核爆地图。

sentences.en: You can sort of see the radius from each supermarket and their theoretical reach.
sentences.zh: 你能看出每个超市的辐射范围以及它们的理论覆盖面。

sentences.en: And in the blank spot that was our neighborhood, they put an X directly on the building we were living.
sentences.zh: 而在作为我们社区的空白点上，他们直接在我们居住的建筑上打了个“X”。

sentences.en: And that was just the start.
The developers wanted to tear down all of the old mill buildings and replace them with yet more retail, with little to no pedestrian access.
sentences.zh: 开发商想要拆除所有老旧的磨坊建筑，用更多的零售店铺取而代之，且几乎不提供行人通道。

sentences.en: And it appears that the only mantra they have is, if you see a space that's underdeveloped, you have a God-given responsibility to develop it.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一的座右铭似乎就是：如果你看到一个未充分开发的地区，你就有上帝赋予的责任去开发它。

sentences.en: And it was basically like having a complete stranger be like, we've been thinking about it, and we think we want to knock your house down.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就像一个完全陌生的人对你说：我们考虑过了，我们觉得我们想把你的房子砸了。

sentences.en: And make it a parking lot if it's cool with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我们要把它变成停车场。

sentences.en: this would be the part of the story where we tell you that Michael and the other residents of Fort Thunder banded together to save their home in the face of the relentless March of Capitol.
sentences.zh: 故事讲到这里，我们会告诉你迈克尔和雷霆堡的其他居民联合起来，在资本无情的铁蹄下拯救他们的家园。

sentences.en: But no, it's not that kind of story.
sentences.zh: 但并没有，这不是那种故事。

sentences.en: Granted, they did save some buildings, but as for Fort Thunder...
sentences.zh: 诚然，他们确实保住了几栋建筑，但至于雷霆堡……

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, they f***ing leveled that.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错，他们他妈的把它给夷为平地了。

sentences.en: They came in with bulldozers and cranes and knocked that sucker flat.
sentences.zh: 他们开着推土机和起重机进来，把那个倒霉蛋砸得粉碎。

sentences.en: The reason we're telling you this story is because of what happened next.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以给你讲这个故事，是因为接下来发生的事情。

sentences.en: Because when I see something like that, I'm like, ho, ho, ho, really?
sentences.zh: 因为当我看到这样的事情时，我的反应是：哦？真的吗？

sentences.en: Michael and his friends had lost their home.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和他的朋友们失去了家园。

sentences.en: And in their mind, it had all started with that first mall.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，这一切都是从那个最初的商场开始的。

sentences.en: That was the original seed of development that had led to everything else.
sentences.zh: 那是引发一切后续发展的最初的开发之种。

sentences.en: And so, talk began of a mall-related action.
sentences.zh: 于是，大家开始讨论一场与商场有关的行动。

sentences.en: Call it art, call it a stunt.
sentences.zh: 管它叫艺术也好，叫恶作剧也罢。

sentences.en: But a plan started to take shape.
Michael and his friends decided that they would find a way to live in the mall for seven days.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和他的朋友们决定，他们要找个办法在商场里住上七天。

sentences.en: And they set a rule for themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们为自己定了一条规则。

sentences.en: And without a second thought of thinking of how unfeasible that is,
sentences.zh: 而且完全没有去想这有多么不切实际，

sentences.en: for our own well-being, we really felt that we had to do it.
sentences.zh: 为了我们自己的心理健康，我们真的觉得自己必须这么做。

sentences.en: And if this sounds like a lark, well, yeah, it kind of was.
sentences.zh: 如果这听起来像是一场恶作剧，嗯，没错，确实有点像。
但这是一场暗地里十分认真的恶作剧。

sentences.en: The four friends, they would eventually number eight,
sentences.zh: 这四个朋友——最终人数达到了八个——

sentences.en: wanted to assert that spaces like the mall could belong just as much to them as to the developers.
sentences.zh: 想要宣示像商场这样的空间不仅属于开发商，也同样属于他们。

sentences.en: To really do this right, they would need to find a space in the mall where they could hide themselves away.
sentences.zh: 要真正把这件事做好，他们需要在商场里找一个可以把自己藏起来的空间。

sentences.en: And Michael had the perfect place in mind.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔脑海里有了完美的地方。

sentences.en: He began to search for that mysterious room that he'd noticed when the mall was under construction all those years before.
sentences.zh: 他开始搜寻那个神秘的房间，那是多年前商场还在建设时他就注意到的地方。

sentences.en: He remembered seeing that the room was connected to a kind of crevice,
sentences.zh: 他记得那个房间连接着某种缝隙，

sentences.en: a narrow gap in the building structure that eventually led out to an exterior wall.
sentences.zh: 那是建筑结构中的一条狭窄通道，最终通往一面外墙。

sentences.en: So one night, Michael went to see if the entrance to that crevice had ever been sealed off.
sentences.zh: 于是有一天晚上，迈克尔去查看那条缝隙的入口是否被封死过。

sentences.en: It was small and sort of hidden, but there was still a crack in the exterior of the mall.
sentences.zh: 它很小而且有点隐蔽，但商场外墙上仍然有一道裂缝。

sentences.en: And so he and his then wife, Adriana, turned themselves sideways and slipped inside.
sentences.zh: 于是他和当时的妻子阿德里安娜侧着身子溜了进去。

sentences.en: And then once you're in at that point, you are exploring a system of caverns, long, weird, vertical caverns.
sentences.zh: 一旦你进到了那个地方，你就是在探索一个洞穴系统，长长的、诡异的垂直洞穴。

sentences.en: And there are places where it just falls down into the lower levels of the mall.
sentences.zh: 有些地方它直接通往商场的底层。

sentences.en: So you've got about a foot and a half of a cliff, but you're looking to a black abyss.
sentences.zh: 所以你脚下大约有一英尺半的悬崖，而你正望着漆黑的深渊。

sentences.en: And then this series of chambers ultimately give you access to this space.
sentences.zh: 接着这一系列房间最终让你能够通往这个空间。

sentences.en: The room was tall and wide, filled with the byproducts of the mall's construction from the years before.
sentences.zh: 这个房间又高又宽，里面堆满了多年前商场施工时的遗留废料。

sentences.en: Broken 2x4s and screws and plastic zip ties that hadn't even been worth removing.
sentences.zh: 破碎的二乘四木方、螺丝以及甚至不值得清理的塑料扎带。

sentences.en: The space had literally been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 这个空间真的被遗忘了。

sentences.en: It was a big space that served no other purpose.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的空间，没有其他任何用途。

sentences.en: It wasn't a storefront and it wasn't a stairwell.
sentences.zh: 它不是店面，也不是楼梯间。

sentences.en: And it was a thrill to physically find it and be like, this is it.
sentences.zh: 亲身找到它并感叹“就是这里”是一件很令人兴奋的事。
这就是我记忆中的那个地方。

sentences.en: The room was in the guts of the building.
sentences.zh: 这个房间位于建筑物的腹地。

sentences.en: The part that no one was ever supposed to use or even really see.
sentences.zh: 那是任何人都永远不该使用、甚至不该真正看到的区域。

sentences.en: But Michael and Adriana saw that it could still be accessed by multiple hidden entry points, including from inside the shopping center itself.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔和阿德里安娜发现，通过多个隐藏的入口依然可以进入它，包括从购物中心内部进入。

sentences.en: If you knew how to get there, you could walk there from the Macy's.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道怎么走，你可以从梅西百货一路走过去。

sentences.en: But as far as they could tell, they were the only people who knew this room existed.
sentences.zh: 但在他们看来，他们是唯一知道这个房间存在的人。

sentences.en: It was at that moment that the friend's scheme started changing.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那一刻，朋友们的计划开始改变了。

sentences.en: The initial plan had been to spend a week in the mall.
sentences.zh: 最初的计划是在商场里度过一周。

sentences.en: But the way they saw it, they were sitting on 750 square feet of underutilized space.
sentences.zh: 但在他们看来，他们手头上拥有750平方英尺未被充分利用的空间。

sentences.en: And then they asked themselves, what would a developer do?
sentences.zh: 然后他们问自己：一个开发商会怎么做？

sentences.en: Because after all, if you see a space that's underdeveloped, you have a God-given responsibility to develop it.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果你看到一个未充分开发的地区，你就有上帝赋予的责任去开发它。

sentences.en: So we decided that perhaps the absolute best thing we could do is just build a condo.
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定，我们能做的绝对最好的一件事就是建一套公寓。

sentences.en: Like that is, that is always the, that's always the answer.
sentences.zh: 就像那样，那永远都是，那永远都是答案。

sentences.en: If you're not sure what to do with the space, just make it a condo.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道该拿这个空间怎么办，那就把它变成公寓吧。

sentences.en: The new plan was no longer to live in the mall for a week.
sentences.zh: 新计划不再是在商场里住上一周。

sentences.en: It was now simply to live in the mall for days at a time, using the room as an apartment.
sentences.zh: 现在的计划很简单：一次在商场里连续住上好几天，把这个房间当成公寓使用。

sentences.en: And while that may sound like a nightmare to everyone, but a few weird artists from Providence,
sentences.zh: 虽然这听起来像是除了普罗维登斯几个怪咖艺术家之外所有人的噩梦，

sentences.en: Michael and his friends got to work on this little project with the excitement of new homeowners.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔和他的朋友们带着新房主的兴奋开始了这项小工程。

sentences.en: Step one, of course, was cleaning.
sentences.zh: 第一步，当然是打扫卫生。

sentences.en: They had to get rid of all that debris.
sentences.zh: 他们必须清理掉所有的垃圾。

sentences.en: It's sort of like, you know, like in a prison break movie.
sentences.zh: 这就有点像，你知道的，就像越狱电影里那样。

sentences.en: We were literally filling up our backpacks with just dirt and grime and then carrying it out of the mall and getting rid of it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的把背包里塞满泥土和污垢，然后把它们运出商场扔掉。

sentences.en: And for every backpack full of debris they took out, they'd bring a pack full of something in.
sentences.zh: 他们每带出一背包垃圾，就会带进一背包东西。

sentences.en: Gallon jugs of water for drinking and cleaning, clamp lights and extension cords for illumination,
sentences.zh: 用于饮用和清洁的加仑装桶装水，用于照明的夹式灯和延长线——

sentences.en: which they plugged into the mall's internal power system, parts for an ad hoc kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些插在商场的内部供电系统上——以及组装临时厨房的零件。

sentences.en: They even built a cinder block wall to hide the space from anyone else who might venture into the cavern complex
sentences.zh: 他们甚至砌了一堵煤渣砖墙，将这个空间藏起来，以防有人误入这个洞穴般的综合体
也就是从它的各个其他入口进来。

sentences.en: We went and got a door that was an exact mirror of the doors they use in the mall.
sentences.zh: 我们去弄了一扇门，跟他们在商场里用的一模一样。

sentences.en: So if you were to find it, unless you're looking really closely at first glance,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你碰巧找到了它，除非你第一眼看得很仔细，

sentences.en: it just looks exactly like it had been built originally.
sentences.zh: 否则它看起来完全就像是原本建好的一样。

sentences.en: Finally, it was time to decorate.
sentences.zh: 最后，到了开始装修的时候。

sentences.en: Anything we could buy at the mall, we would.
sentences.zh: 只要能在商场里买到的东西，我们都会买。

sentences.en: A low table came in on top of that, proudly perched with a television and our PlayStation.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，又搬进来一张矮桌，上面摆着一台电视机和我们的PlayStation。

sentences.en: But if we couldn't buy it at the mall, we'd have to bring it into the mall.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们在商场里买不到，我们就得想办法把它带进商场里。

sentences.en: And that's for the large pieces like the china hutch or the four-piece sectional couch.
sentences.zh: 对于像餐具柜或四件套组合沙发这样的大件东西，就是这样的。

sentences.en: Nobody looked twice that you brought pieces of a couch through the mall.
sentences.zh: 没有人会多看一眼你把沙发的零件带进商场。

sentences.en: How did you get that in there?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么把它弄进去的？

sentences.en: In broad daylight, we avoided the night and sort of worked with the ebb and flow of the mall.
sentences.zh: 在大白天，我们避开夜晚，顺着商场的人流起伏来干活。

sentences.en: We were just part of the living organism of its daily activities.
sentences.zh: 我们只是它日常活动这个活生生有机体的一部分。

sentences.en: It may seem risky trying to furnish a secret apartment with a nested coffee table,
sentences.zh: 试图用一张可嵌套的咖啡桌来装修一个秘密公寓，这听起来可能有点冒险，

sentences.en: but to anyone watching, it was just a person walking through a mall with a nested coffee table
sentences.zh: 但对任何观察者来说，这只是一个人带着一张可嵌套的咖啡桌走过商场，

sentences.en: that they just bought at the mall.
sentences.zh: 而这张桌子是他们刚在商场里买的。

sentences.en: There's simply no such thing as a suspicious consumer item in a building that is dedicated to consumerism.
sentences.zh: 在一个致力于消费主义的建筑里，根本不存在什么可疑的消费品这回事。

sentences.en: The friends would sometimes stay in the secret apartment for several weeks in a row,
sentences.zh: 朋友们有时会在这个秘密公寓里连续住上好几个星期，

sentences.en: just living, watching television, making collages with shadow boxes they bought at Pottery Barn,
sentences.zh: 就在这里生活、看电视、用他们在Pottery Barn买的深框画框做拼贴画，

sentences.en: even cooking in the ad-hoc kitchen.
sentences.zh: 甚至在这个临时厨房里做饭。

sentences.en: Michael remembers burning some waffles with a waffle iron
sentences.zh: 迈克尔记得曾用华夫饼机烤糊了一些华夫饼，

sentences.en: and wondering if the smoke would give them away.
sentences.zh: 并且担心烟雾会暴露他们的行踪。

sentences.en: And when the eight friends weren't enjoying their secret apartment,
sentences.zh: 当这八个朋友没有在享受他们的秘密公寓时，

sentences.en: they were enjoying the mall, not as shoppers, but as residents.
sentences.zh: 他们就在享受商场，不是作为购物者，而是作为居民。

sentences.en: Thanks to its late-night movie theater, the mall almost never closed.
sentences.zh: 多亏了里面深夜营业的电影院，这家商场几乎从不打烊。

sentences.en: So sometimes they would just roam the building with no goal in mind, observing its many moods.
sentences.zh: 所以有时他们会漫无目的地在建筑里闲逛，观察它千变万化的情绪。

sentences.en: There are times when that entire building probably had maybe 10 people in it,
sentences.zh: 有时候，整栋大楼里可能总共只有大约10个人，

sentences.en: like in the middle of the night.
There'd be security officers, there'd be cleaning staff.
sentences.zh: 会有保安，也会有清洁人员。

sentences.en: And it's a really wonderful time because it's like having a public park four levels deep all to yourself.
sentences.zh: 那真是一段美妙的时光，因为感觉就像是把一个四层楼深的公共公园完全据为己有。

sentences.en: And in those moments, there's a sense of ownership, and I just feel really good.
sentences.zh: 在那些时刻，有一种强烈的归属感，让我感觉非常棒。

sentences.en: Weeks turned to months, and eventually years.
sentences.zh: 几周变成了几个月，最终变成了几年。

sentences.en: Out of the emotional rubble of Fort Thunder, they'd finally found their refuge.
sentences.zh: 从雷霆堡的情感废墟中，他们终于找到了自己的避难所。

sentences.en: And all thanks to the mall's developers,
sentences.zh: 这一切都要归功于商场的开发商，

sentences.en: who had accidentally provided a sanctuary from the world they were busy developing.
sentences.zh: 是他们无意中提供了一个庇护所，让他们免受他们正忙着开发的那个世界的影响。

sentences.en: But as the old saying goes, there comes a time in every man's life when he must stop living at the mall.
sentences.zh: 但正如老话所说，每个人的生命中都会有这样一个时刻：他必须停止在商场里生活。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the seed got planted that this whole thing was going to unravel,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，一种预感开始生根发芽，觉得这一切都要穿帮了，

sentences.en: and that's because we had a break in.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们遭到了入室盗窃。

sentences.en: One day, they came back to the apartment only to discover that someone had kicked open the door
sentences.zh: 有一天，他们回到公寓，却发现有人一脚踹开了门，

sentences.en: and stole on the PlayStation, along with several other small items,
sentences.zh: 偷走了PlayStation，以及其他几件小东西，

sentences.en: including the art they had made and a photo album.
sentences.zh: 包括他们制作的艺术品和一个相册。

sentences.en: We're like, this is a very odd burglary.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，这是一起非常奇怪的入室盗窃。

sentences.en: Like, they didn't take the things of value.
sentences.zh: 就像是，他们没有拿走有价值的东西。

sentences.en: They only took the things that were, like, super personal.
sentences.zh: 他们只拿走了那些超级私人的东西。

sentences.en: Michael and his friends were spooked.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和他的朋友们被吓到了。

sentences.en: They had managed to hide the apartment for four years.
sentences.zh: 他们设法将这间公寓隐藏了四年。

sentences.en: But now, someone knew about the room.
sentences.zh: 但现在，有人知道了这个房间的存在。

sentences.en: Someone who could come back at any time, and who seemed to be interested in them.
sentences.zh: 一个随时可能回来，而且似乎对他们很感兴趣的人。

sentences.en: They decided from now on, they'd only stay there at night,
sentences.zh: 他们决定从今以后，只在夜间待在那里，

sentences.en: when the chances of being caught were low.
And crucially, they would double down on another rule they'd had since almost the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，他们将加倍严格执行他们从几乎一开始就遵守的另一条规则。

sentences.en: Don't physically bring anyone here who wasn't involved in the making of it.
sentences.zh: 绝对不要把任何没有参与建造它的人带到这里来。

sentences.en: So a lot of my very, very good and best friends never saw the space.
sentences.zh: 所以我的很多很多至交好友从未见过这个空间。

sentences.en: And I'm the one who took that rule and broke it.
sentences.zh: 而我就是那个打破了这条规则的人。

sentences.en: Michael was hosting a visiting artist from Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔当时正在接待一位来访的香港艺术家。

sentences.en: He was driving her to the bus station on her way out of town.
sentences.zh: 他正开车送她去汽车站，她准备离开这个小镇。

sentences.en: And we're driving past the mall, and I say to myself,
sentences.zh: 当我们开车经过商场时，我对自己说，

sentences.en: How could this possibly backfire on me?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能会对我有不好的影响呢？

sentences.en: So, I brought her into the space.
sentences.zh: 于是，我把她带进了这个空间。
她的脑子彻底被震撼了。

sentences.en: You've got to remember that this is at the peak of its build-out.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，当时正是它建设的巅峰时期。
迈克尔向贾法展示了一切。

sentences.en: The couch, the lights, the television.
They were just days away from installing a water tank and a wood floor.
sentences.zh: 他们再过几天就要安装水箱和木地板了。

sentences.en: In spite of the break-in, after four years of work,
sentences.zh: 尽管经历过入室盗窃，但在经历了四年的努力之后，

sentences.en: the apartment was on the verge of feeling like a real home.
sentences.zh: 这间公寓终于让人感觉像一个真正的家了。

sentences.en: But when we're leaving, I hear walkie-talkie on the other side of the door within two feet of us.
sentences.zh: 但当我们正要离开时，我听到门外两英尺处传来了对讲机的声音。

sentences.en: And when the door opens, it's three dudes in ties and sports jackets.
sentences.zh: 当门打开时，是三个系着领带、穿着运动夹克的家伙。

sentences.en: And I realize in that moment, I internalize that it's over.
sentences.zh: 我当时就意识到，并且深深地感到：一切都结束了。

sentences.en: It turned out that the earlier break-in had been the work of two of the mall's newest security guards.
sentences.zh: 原来，早先的入室盗窃是商场里两个最新的保安干的。

sentences.en: Instead of removing everything, they had taken the personal items in hopes of figuring out who Michael and his friends were.
sentences.zh: 他们没有搬走所有东西，而是拿走了私人物品，希望能弄清楚迈克尔和他的朋友们是谁。

sentences.en: Now that Michael had been foolish enough to come back during the day, they had their man.
sentences.zh: 既然迈克尔蠢到在大白天回来，他们可就抓到人了。

sentences.en: General Growth Properties, the company that owned the mall,
sentences.zh: 通用增长地产公司（General Growth Properties），也就是拥有这家商场的公司，

sentences.en: did not take kindly to the secret apartment in its walls.
sentences.zh: 对墙里的这个秘密公寓可一点也高兴不起来。

sentences.en: After being handed over to the police and interrogated, Jaffa was eventually let go.
sentences.zh: 在被移交给警方并接受审讯后，贾法最终被释放了。

sentences.en: But Michael soon found himself standing in front of a judge in criminal court,
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔很快发现自己站在刑事法庭的法官面前，

sentences.en: charged with breaking and entering, and felony trespass.
sentences.zh: 被控非法侵入和重罪私闯。

sentences.en: By the time I get to court, the mall has hired a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 等我到了法庭，商场已经请了律师。

sentences.en: And they launch into all these details about the illegal things that I have done.
sentences.zh: 他们滔滔不绝地列举了我所做过的所有违法细节。

sentences.en: And I keep my mouth shut.
sentences.zh: 我则紧闭双唇一言不发。

sentences.en: But, but, after they've gone through this laundry list of illegal activities,
sentences.zh: 但是，但是，在他们历数了这一长串违法行为之后，

sentences.en: this gave Mr. Townsend access to an apartment that they had built over several years
sentences.zh: “这让汤森先生得以进入一个他们历时数年建造的公寓，

sentences.en: that had the following things in it,
and goes on to list in detail what the apartment looked like.
sentences.zh: 然后开始详细列举这个公寓长什么样。

sentences.en: Including the coffee table, the television, a copy of the game Grand Theft Auto,
sentences.zh: 包括咖啡桌、电视机、《侠盗猎车手》游戏光盘、

sentences.en: an eight-foot china hutch, a four-piece sectional couch,
sentences.zh: 八英尺长的餐具柜、四件套组合沙发、

sentences.en: silverware for eight with matching glassware,
sentences.zh: 供八人使用的银器及配套玻璃器皿、

sentences.en: And the more details this lawyer gives, the more the judge just looks around.
sentences.zh: 这位律师给出的细节越多，法官就越是四处张望。

sentences.en: And he's like, what's happening here?
sentences.zh: 他好像在想，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And the judge hustles advisors close to him,
sentences.zh: 法官把顾问叫到身边急切商议，

sentences.en: And then he looks up, looks me dead in the eyes, and he goes,
sentences.zh: 然后他抬起头，直勾勾地盯着我的眼睛，说道：

sentences.en: this is not a criminal act.
We're not, we're not sure exactly what it was,
sentences.zh: 我们虽然说不清这到底算什么，

sentences.en: but this is not a crime.
Whether the judge was perceiving a deep legal truth at the heart of this case,
sentences.zh: 无论法官是洞察到了本案核心深处的某种深刻法律真理，

sentences.en: or Michael was just the beneficiary of an incredible amount of white privilege,
sentences.zh: 还是迈克尔只是沾了巨大白人特权的光，
迈克尔可能永远都不会知道了。

sentences.en: In the end, he was slapped with a misdemeanor for trespassing and released.
sentences.zh: 最终，他因私闯民宅被判轻罪并被释放。

sentences.en: He had lived on and off in the secret apartment for nearly four years,
sentences.zh: 他断断续续地在这个秘密公寓里住了近四年，

sentences.en: and it was going to cost him almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 而这几乎没有花他什么钱。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean he got away entirely scot-free.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他完全全身而退了。

sentences.en: Just before Michael left the mall,
sentences.zh: 就在迈克尔离开商场前，

sentences.en: the mall security team handed him a piece of paper,
sentences.zh: 商场安保团队递给他一张纸，

sentences.en: the same piece of paper they hand to brawlers, shoplifters,
sentences.zh: 就是那种发给打架斗殴者、商店扒手，

sentences.en: and anyone else who has overstayed their welcome
sentences.zh: 以及任何在这个最私密的公共空间里逗留太久的人的纸。

sentences.en: in this most private of public spaces.
sentences.zh: 这是一张标准的马尼拉纸，

sentences.en: It's this standardized manila piece of paper,
which has a map of the mall,
sentences.zh: 整个地图周围画着一条红线，

sentences.en: and it has this red line around the whole thing,
and you have to sign it,
sentences.zh: 上面写着你不能越过那条红线。

sentences.en: and it says you can't cross that red line.
sentences.zh: 所以他们明确表示你永远不能再回来了。

sentences.en: So they make it clear you're never coming back.

sentences.zh: 迈克尔依然住在商场附近。

sentences.en: Michael still lives right near the mall.
sentences.zh: 但他去那占地13英亩的商场附近闲逛的日子已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: But his days of running anywhere near its 13 acres are over.
And the biggest bummer for me is that
if I want to go to downtown,
the path that you bring your bike through
is through the center of the mall
sentences.zh: 也就是它横跨河流的地方。

sentences.en: where it bridges over the river.
sentences.zh: 既然我被禁止进入商场，

sentences.en: And now that I'm banned from the mall,
I have to bike around it.
sentences.zh: 我已经绕着它骑了10年车了。

sentences.en: And I've biked around it for 10 years.

sentences.zh: 我从来没有违反过这条规则。

sentences.en: I have never broken this rule.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的再也回不去了？

sentences.en: So you really can never go back?

sentences.zh: 自从我们播出那个故事以来，
迈克尔确实遵守了禁令。
在新纪录片的高潮部分，

sentences.zh: 他偷偷溜了回去，想看看公寓还剩下什么。

sentences.en: he sneaks back in to see what's left of the apartment.
sentences.zh: 但他发现的只有一扇门和几个煤渣砖。

sentences.en: But all he finds is a door and a couple of cinder blocks.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，商场的日子也不好过。

sentences.zh: 其管理公司已经无力偿还

sentences.zh: 法官裁定将该购物中心交由接管人管理。

sentences.zh: 律师约翰·多西和马克·鲁索

sentences.en: were appointed to turn around the mall's finances
sentences.zh: 被委任来扭转购物中心的财务状况

sentences.zh: 作为他们宣传推广的一部分，

sentences.zh: 他们实际上赦免了汤森。

sentences.en: They commissioned him to install art pieces
sentences.zh: 他们委托他安装艺术装置

sentences.en: hosted a premiere of the documentary.
sentences.zh: 举办了这部纪录片的首映礼。

sentences.zh: 多西甚至深入购物中心的地下室

sentences.zh: 在曾经的公寓原址拍照留念。

sentences.zh: 拯救购物中心的想法之一

sentences.zh: 《秘密购物中心公寓》目前正在部分城市上映。

sentences.zh: 我在一家类似苹果蜂（Applebee's）的餐厅当杂工

sentences.zh: 路过那些卷闸门依然拉下的店铺。

sentences.zh: 到了中午，家庭顾客成了主流，
